en: After an internal event ends, where do the videos, photos, scripts, and project plans go? In many companies, along with the excitement of the day, those materials also become "retired from service" and remain buried in some folder, lost in daily operations. However, Kim Gong-yong, Representative Director of Orgiast Co., Ltd., which handles internal event and creative production, says, "Event materials can sometimes hold more value 10 years later than at the moment they were created." We asked the Representative Director in detail why past materials become management assets and what kind of operation is necessary to draw out that value.

ja: 費用の内訳が明示されているか、追加費用の発生条件が明確に説明されているかを確認しましょう。「一式〇〇円」という丸投げ型の見積もりは、後から追加費用が発生しやすく、予算管理が難しくなります。項目ごとの内訳が分かる見積もりを出してくれる会社は、費用に対する透明性が高いと判断できます。
en: Check whether the cost breakdown is clearly presented and whether the conditions for additional charges are explicitly explained. A lump‑sum quote such as "一式XX円" tends to generate later additional costs and makes budget management difficult. Companies that provide quotations with itemized breakdowns can be judged as having high cost transparency.
